selection_reasoning: G3 fails: the cost ratio against the faithful comparator is not met, which is the study's primary hypothesis and the condition the #1608 stop rule attaches to. G3 is read before G4 because EXPECTED_TERMINALS.json enumerates COST_RATIO_GATE_MISSED ahead of DP_OPTIMALITY_GAP_EXCEEDED, and a secondary optimality diagnostic cannot be the headline once the primary comparison has already failed.
G4 also fails; both are listed in failing_gates.
The independent recomputation disagrees with the supplied result on terminal, gates.G6.passed. No claim may be read from a disputed computation.

bootstrap.method: stratified percentile bootstrap, paired by world identity

G1.statement: ORION success noninferior to faithful_active_voi with margin -0.01.
G1.operationalisation: Per-stratum point test (terminal scope) AND pooled point test AND Holm-adjusted bootstrap support for the pooled noninferiority test.

G2.operationalisation: Terminal reading governs: every stratum where A3 holds, derived as the strata whose assumptions_violated does not contain A3. The literal every-stratum reading is reported beside it.

G3.statement: Paired expected-cost ratio orion_level_monotone / faithful_active_voi < 0.80 AND its 95% upper confidence bound < 0.80.
G3.operationalisation: Ratio of matched mean costs pooled over every stratum, with the stratified percentile bootstrap UCB, plus Holm-adjusted support.

components.decision_scope_rationale: PROTOCOL leaves G3 unscoped while scoping G4, G5 and G7 explicitly; pooling the violation controls that G5 requires to be null would let G5 make G3 unsatisfiable

G4.statement: ORION mean cost <= 1.10 x exact_dp_oracle optimum on the theorem_valid stratum.
G4.operationalisation: Point comparison of unconditional mean costs on theorem_valid. Absent or incomplete oracle coverage leaves G4 UNMEASURED, never passed.

G5.statement: The ORION cost advantage disappears on every assumption-violation control stratum.
G5.operationalisation: Per violation stratum the advantage is declared present when the matched cost ratio is below 0.80 AND its 95% UCB is below 0.80, evaluated UNADJUSTED. G5 passes when no violation stratum shows it.

G6.statement: Reported jointly with G3: ORION cost versus gain_per_cost_greedy at equal success and safety. Theorem C predicts ORION is NOT lower.
G6.operationalisation: gain_per_cost_greedy matches-or-beats ORION when it is noninferior on success at the registered -0.01 margin, no worse on forbidden-mutation rate, and no ORION cost advantage can be established on the matched set (point ratio AND Holm-adjusted UCB below 1.0). G6 passes when it does NOT match-or-beat.

components.decision_scope_rationale: read jointly with G3, so computed on the same world scope (EXPECTED_TERMINALS reporting_rule.must_report_G3_and_G6_together)

G7.statement: On the ratio_aligned stratum, orion_level_monotone and gain_per_cost_greedy must produce identical orderings and identical expected cost. Any difference is an instrument fault and forces CANNOT_CHECK.
G7.operationalisation: Per world on ratio_aligned: identical (kind, level, target) action sequence AND identical total cost within 1e-9, plus identical means.

anchor_reproduction_gate.reason: PROTOCOL requires a per-world-set parameterised anchor gate, but no committed rates for this world family appear in PROTOCOL.json, EXPECTED_TERMINALS.json, TRACE_SCHEMA_V1.json or THEORY.md. The checker refuses to hardcode any other world set's rates: that is precisely the runner defect that lost R4's replication arm.

fields.note: The result claims a pass on an anchor reference keyed to this world set and states no hardcoded rates were used. That basis is not part of the frozen packet, so this checker can neither confirm nor contradict it: reported as unverified, and not counted as a pass.

protocol_defects: PROTOCOL.json statistics.interval_method declares a frozen bootstrap seed but no seed value appears in any frozen document. The checker used 20260828 and probed terminal stability across other seeds.

PROTOCOL.json statistics.anchor_reproduction_gate is required and parameterised per world set, but the packet freezes no committed rates for this world family, so the anchor gate cannot be reproduced from traces alone.

warnings.detail: row carries fields outside TRACE_SCHEMA_V1; they name no derived quantity, so they are reported rather than refused
